_nguon: CHT-1 — English overlay of chiem_tinh_cung_hoang_dao_kb.json (editorial team).

khi.y: quick-thinking, loves exchange, needs ideas and people

thong_linh.y: opens a season, good at getting new things going

kien_dinh.y: the middle of a season, good at holding steady and making things last

linh_hoat.y: closes a season, good at adapting and handing over

diem_manh: Acts first without waiting to be asked
Speaks plainly, so people know where they stand
Recovers quickly after a setback
diem_mu: Rushes, deciding before the facts are in
Keen at the start, bored once the work turns routine
Easily impatient with slower people
bach_duong.tinh_yeu: Drawn to people who are direct and lively, with no games. Often the one who makes the first move. The bond lasts longer with a shared project to work on, and when you learn to hear the other person out before answering.
bach_duong.cong_viec: Suits work that needs a start, quick action and clear targets. Loses interest in repetitive tasks; pair up with someone good at seeing things through.
bach_duong.tien_bac: Earns well when willing to act; tends to spend on impulse. A separate pot you do not touch for three months helps the money stay.
bach_duong.tu_soi: What did I start with energy lately but have not finished?
viec: Before a big decision, sleep on it one night before answering.
Each week pick one unfinished task and close it before taking on a new one.

diem_manh: Patient, steady until the work is done
Keeps promises; promises little but delivers
Enjoys comfort and makes home and work pleasant
diem_mu: Slow to change their mind even after seeing they were wrong
Can be possessive of people and things
Puts off tasks with no immediate payoff
kim_nguu.tinh_yeu: Falls in love slowly but surely and needs to feel safe before opening up. Shows love through deeds: cooking a meal, fixing something, being on time. Can turn jealous when the relationship feels shaky.
kim_nguu.cong_viec: Suits work that needs persistence, quality and visible results. Does well at their own pace; struggles where plans change all the time.
kim_nguu.tien_bac: Has a knack for saving and buying things that last. The trap is leaving money in one place too long to avoid learning something new.
kim_nguu.tu_soi: Which habit am I keeping only because it is familiar, not because it still works?
viec: Set one day a month to review one spending habit or way of working.
In a disagreement, say what you need instead of going quiet.

diem_manh: Learns fast and grasps a new idea on first hearing
Can talk with many kinds of people
Flexible, quick to change course when things change
diem_mu: Spreads thin, starting many things and finishing few
Gets bored going deep on one topic for long
Words sometimes run ahead of thought
song_tu.tinh_yeu: Needs someone to talk to, with laughter and new things to share. Falls for a mind more than a face. The relationship needs room for both to keep friends and interests of their own.
song_tu.cong_viec: Suits work full of exchange, information and constant change. Does well with varied tasks; a teammate or a task list helps keep the pace.
song_tu.tien_bac: Often has several small income streams; tends to spend on new gadgets and courses. Logging expenses weekly shows where the money goes.
song_tu.tu_soi: Of the ten things I am chasing, which one is truly worth finishing?
viec: Before promising, check your calendar for room.
Each evening note three things you finished that day, however small.

diem_manh: Senses how others feel and knows how to care for them
Grateful, keeps memories, values family
Good instincts about people
diem_mu: Worries about things that have not happened
Remembers old hurts for a long time
Mood rises and falls with the atmosphere around them
cu_giai.tinh_yeu: Loves deeply and loyally and needs a sense of home. Shows love through care. Things get hard when you guess instead of asking; saying what you need is the skill to practise.
cu_giai.cong_viec: Suits caring and nurturing work and keeping a team's mood warm. Does well where people trust you; uncomfortable in cold, cut-throat settings.
cu_giai.tien_bac: Likes saving for family and for hard times. Tends to spend out of kindness; set a monthly amount for helping others in advance.
cu_giai.tu_soi: Have I recently told anyone what I need, or did I hope they would just know?
viec: Keep one evening a week just for yourself.
When worried, write down the worry and one small thing you can do right now.

diem_manh: Warm and generous with the people they love
Willing to step forward and take responsibility in public
Creative, with taste, wanting every task done beautifully
diem_mu: Needs recognition, stays hurt when overlooked
Finds it hard to admit mistakes in front of others
Tends to take on everything to keep the lead role
su_tu.tinh_yeu: Loves wholeheartedly, likes to spoil and be spoiled. Needs sincere praise. The bond lasts when you let your partner shine too.
su_tu.cong_viec: Suits leading roles, standing in front of others and work with a personal stamp. Does well when trusted; practise sharing tasks and praising your team.
su_tu.tien_bac: Open-handed with friends, likes things of quality. A set budget for parties and gifts keeps you generous without running short.
su_tu.tu_soi: Am I doing this because I enjoy it, or because I want to be seen?
viec: Each week give one co-worker specific, honest praise.
When wrong, say 'I got this part wrong' in one sentence.

xu_nu.hinh_tuong: the maiden holding a sheaf of wheat
diem_manh: Meticulous, spots small errors others miss
Likes to help in practical ways
Organised, works with a clear process
diem_mu: Sets the bar too high and is rarely satisfied
Fault-finding can turn into criticism
Worries because everything must be right
xu_nu.tinh_yeu: Shows love through practical attention: remembering dates, handling small chores. Needs time to trust. Things feel lighter when you praise more than you correct and accept that your partner is not perfect.
xu_nu.cong_viec: Suits work that needs accuracy, analysis and process improvement. Does well with clear standards; set a limit on rounds of revision.
xu_nu.tien_bac: Spends carefully, rarely on impulse. The trap is worrying so much that you will not spend on things worth doing.
xu_nu.tu_soi: Is this good enough to hand over, or am I still fixing it out of fear of criticism?
viec: Set a stop time for each round of edits.
Before giving feedback, name one thing the other person did well.

diem_manh: Sees both sides of a story
Good at making peace and keeping things pleasant
An eye for beauty and balance
diem_mu: Struggles to choose, afraid a choice will upset someone
Goes along with others and hides their own view
Avoids conflict and lets problems drag on
thien_binh.tinh_yeu: Wants a true partner to discuss and decide with. Values courtesy and respect. The bond lasts when you dare to say no and state what you want.
thien_binh.cong_viec: Suits negotiation, networking, design and law. Does well in a cooperative team; set a deadline for every round of weighing options.
thien_binh.tien_bac: Likes to spend on beauty and on relationships. Agreeing up front with whoever shares the bill avoids awkwardness later.
thien_binh.tu_soi: When did I last nod while wanting to say no?
viec: For small things, give yourself five minutes to choose and stop.
State your own view first, then ask others.

diem_manh: Highly focused, follows things to the root
Loyal, keeps the secrets of those who trust them
Sees the real motive behind the words
diem_mu: Slow to trust, tests other people
Holds on to hurt for a long time
Wants control of everything
bo_cap.tinh_yeu: Loves intensely and needs complete honesty. Slow to open up, but once open stays attached for long. Things get easier when you voice a doubt directly instead of quietly testing your partner.
bo_cap.cong_viec: Suits work that needs digging deep: research, crisis handling, risk management. Does well when fully trusted; practise sharing information with the team.
bo_cap.tien_bac: Good at long-range planning and likes to know exactly where money is. Shared money is best kept on clear paper to avoid suspicion.
bo_cap.tu_soi: What am I holding inside that I have not said plainly to the person concerned?
viec: When in doubt, ask one direct question instead of testing.
Write down one old grievance you want to drop, and leave it there.

nhan_ma.hinh_tuong: the archer, half human and half horse
diem_manh: Optimistic, quick to spot opportunity
Loves learning, travel and new things
Honest, says what they think
diem_mu: Promises more than they can deliver
Tells the truth but forgets how to say it
Dislikes commitment and may walk away when hemmed in
nhan_ma.tinh_yeu: Needs a kindred companion to travel, learn and laugh with. Cannot stand being controlled. The bond lasts when both keep their freedom and share a plan to work toward.
nhan_ma.cong_viec: Suits wide-horizon work: travel, teaching, links across places. Does well with autonomy; pair up with someone good at details.
nhan_ma.tien_bac: Easily spends on experiences and trips. A separate travel fund lets you enjoy yourself without shortchanging the essentials.
nhan_ma.tu_soi: Am I promising anyone something I know will be hard to keep?
viec: Before saying yes, count how many free hours you really have.
Pair honesty with a question: 'How does that sound to you?'.

diem_manh: Disciplined, sets long goals and gets there
Responsible, trusted with important work
Practical, knows their limits
diem_mu: Rarely allows rest and treats rest as laziness
Finds it hard to ask for help, carries the load alone
Turns gloomy when a plan runs behind schedule
ma_ket.tinh_yeu: Takes love seriously and thinks long term early on. Shows it by taking care of things more than with sweet words. Warmer when you make time to play, not only to plan.
ma_ket.cong_viec: Suits work with a clear path and high responsibility: management, building foundations for the long run. Does well in clear hierarchies; learn to delegate.
ma_ket.tien_bac: Good at saving and investing for the long haul. The trap is saving so hard you will not spend on health and enjoyment.
ma_ket.tu_soi: When did I last do something just for fun, not because it was useful?
viec: Book rest in your calendar the way you book meetings.
Each week say one word of thanks or affection to family.

diem_manh: Thinks differently and sees new ways of doing things
Cares about the common good and fairness in a group
Friendly with many kinds of people
diem_mu: Keeps emotional distance and can seem hard to reach
Stubborn about their ideas once convinced
Tends to brush off everyday chores
bao_binh.tinh_yeu: Wants someone who is both friend and lover and respects freedom and opinions. Shows affection in their own way, rarely by the book. Closer when you share feelings, not only ideas.
bao_binh.cong_viec: Suits innovation, technology, community work and improving systems. Does well when free to try new methods; be patient with the small daily steps.
bao_binh.tien_bac: Has fresh ideas for earning; tends to skip tracking spending. A simple monthly spreadsheet keeps the rhythm.
bao_binh.tu_soi: Do the people close to me know how I am feeling right now?
viec: Finish one small everyday task each day before thinking big.
In a debate, repeat the other person's point before making yours.

song_ngu.hinh_tuong: two fish swimming in opposite directions
diem_manh: Deeply sympathetic, understands what others feel
Rich imagination, suited to the arts
Gentle and quick to forgive
diem_mu: Finds it hard to say no, so kindness gets exploited
Dreams a lot but is slow to act
Dodges hard things by putting them off
song_ngu.tinh_yeu: Loves romantically and is ready to give a lot. Needs someone gentle yet steady. Healthier when you keep clear boundaries and do not carry all of your partner's sadness.
song_ngu.cong_viec: Suits creative, caring and arts work. Does well in a quiet space; keep a schedule and concrete deadlines.
song_ngu.tien_bac: Big-hearted, quick to lend or to spend on feelings. Setting a lending limit in advance protects both the friendship and the money.
song_ngu.tu_soi: For the thing I have long dreamed of doing, what is the smallest step I can take this week?
viec: Practise saying: 'Let me think it over and get back to you'.
Turn one idea into three tasks, each with a date.
